sql_query:
SELECT
  CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS month_start,
  ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
